evidence.summary: 为 DSH 提供本地 SQLite 项目看板、Agent 任务工具、原生会话执行与自动化。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 src/client/index.tsx、skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md、README.md、src/index.ts、src/tool/index.ts、src/sqlite/provider.ts、src/execution/index.ts、src/service/index.ts、src/cli.ts、src/domain/policy.ts、src/automation/index.ts、cordis.patch.yml；SQLite作任务权威，精确版本和claim事务约束模型工具；原生Agent/Goal执行并提交review，Web/CLI人类入口accept。

只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。

findings.text: 需要跨会话管理本地项目的 DSH 操作者，可跟踪任务要求、claim与人工review，成果仍需独立验收。
SQLite作任务权威，精确版本和claim事务约束模型工具；原生Agent/Goal执行并提交review，Web/CLI人类入口accept。
根组件完整inventory，定向读取SQLite版本/claim/review/事务、工具权限、原生执行、孤儿恢复、调度和人类入口；不完整审计GUI、附件全过程或外部执行，不执行目标代码。
@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard 0.1.11、Apache-2.0，原生host/client、CLI和manage-taskboard Skill组合。作者安装/模块加载结果与本轮源码证据分开，未验发布产物对应。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Node ^22.19或>=24 | 本地库必需声明 | node:sqlite | 模块加载不代表GUI/执行兼容 |
| DSH web、原生任务服务 | 看板必需；Agent服务按执行使用 | 客户端、会话、工具与模型 | 缺服务不形成相应执行能力 |
| 同一已确认数据库与附件目录 | 持久化必需 | 任务唯一权威与附件 | 错库会看到不同事实，先对路径 |
| 模型、preset和受控目录 | 自动执行必需 | 原生Agent办任务 | 需另控工具权限、预算与副作用 |
| 宿主认证及本地CLI/DB权限 | 人类边界必需 | 约束accept和直接写库 | 本插件不是多租户隔离层 |
[Q03](#research-q03) 的成本表分开模型资源、附件存储和人工验收/恢复，金额和时间未知。
[Q03](#research-q03) 用独立测试库和可丢弃目录从手动闭环试起，再显式开少量自动规则。出现重复执行、claim与会话不符或权限/预算不明，就暂停规则并对账外部副作用，保留数据库与附件。
[Q03](#research-q03) 的效果表只支持任务组织与权限接线，不输出净效率或生产可靠性结论。
[Q01](#research-q01) 同事务版本和claim有实际实现；[Q02](#research-q02) 孤儿状态与不确定配额可见值得借鉴。跨资源恢复仍需操作ID和实际结果，不能将owner字符串或human kind当OS权限。
[Q01](#research-q01) 把持久任务、owner认领、宿主原生会话和人工review接在一起，比聊天便签多了可拒绝的竞争与版本边界。 [Q02](#research-q02) 仍保留宿主执行归属，工作流仅指导而非自动引擎。
[Q02](#research-q02) human actor是入口信任约定，不能约束已获CLI/数据库能力的进程；Goal complete与非空验证文本不证明成果合格，SQLite事务也不包外部副作用。
[Q04](#research-q04) 提出版本、产物和真实验证记录绑定的验收包，检验能否减少误接受；相对现有human review新增可核材料，而非另设状态标签。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 相对任务清单集成已有SQLite和宿主服务，novelty小幅9；同事务版本/claim与宿主执行边界有实质取舍，mechanism15但无分布式副作用保证不升显著；owner、review和不确定配额模式可迁移，transferability10但未跨宿主验证；同库统一事实较聊天与看板分离有实质简化8，运维与外部对账阻止更高档。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 认领/提交/人工接受改变交接责任，workflow实质18；review与done区分形成明确交付验收单元，delivery15但Q02验证文本不能证明质量；reach5仅面向已有DSH用户未验新群体；economics4为本地任务组织可能减少重复工作的有限机制，无净成本数据不升实质。

recommendation.reason: 已有本地 DSH 项目且愿意人工验收的操作者可以在独立测试库中试用 Taskboard 管理多会话任务。它较聊天清单增加事务认领、版本检查和原生会话关联，但没有证明自动任务质量或外部副作用可安全重放。出现重复执行、claim与会话不符或权限预算不明时，用户应暂停规则并保留数据库和附件，回到人工分派与对账。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 持久任务、claim和review具体对应多会话交接摩擦，超过只有用途的50%档；缺独立真实项目需求强度证据，取75%档23不满分。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 565–605与688–690有真实版本/owner/accept机制，较聊天清单在并发交接有实质改善，超过50%解释增量；Q02外部副作用和人类入口权限仍需收窄，取75%档19不取25。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)覆盖注册、工具、SQLite、worker、review与恢复/配额，超过片段25%档；无目标运行、跨Host或实际任务，取源码上限50%档13。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 有可识别的停规则、保库和手动退路，超过恢复重要缺口25%档；仍需维护库/附件、模型预算和人工验收/故障对账，取50%档10，未证明负担较轻到75%。

publication.summaries.text: 为 DSH 提供本地 SQLite 项目看板、Agent 任务工具、原生会话执行与自动化。

items.模型工具: 任务读取、认领、评论、review与阻塞等窄工具，不含accept。

| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 项目任务与活动 | 持久化要求、状态、评论和关系 | 同一SQLite权威，不能由看板状态证明成果 |
| 排他认领 | 防同库非owner及旧版本写入 | 不等于外部文件/进程全局锁 |
| 原生Agent执行 | 任务映射到会话与Goal | 需要模型/工具权限，副作用另核 |
| 人工review | 将Agent提交与最终done分开 | human入口依赖宿主和本地权限 |
| 规则调度 | 周期认领todo并管理并发 | 配额未知可暂停，并发不是费用预算 |
| 工作流指导 | 给执行者提供持久节点说明 | worker不会自动逐节点运行 |

data.reports:
# DSH Taskboard > 为 DSH 提供本地 SQLite 项目看板、Agent 任务工具、原生会话执行与自动化。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard) - **版本号**：0.1.11（[固定提交 69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard/tree/69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-02（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 已核根注册、模型工具、claim/事务、Goal到review、孤儿恢复、配额与Web/CLI边界。未执行目标或跨Host故障，工作流节点不当自动运行保证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要跨会话管理本地项目的 DSH 操作者，可跟踪任务要求、claim与人工review，成果仍需独立验收。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 把持久任务、owner认领、宿主原生会话和人工review接在一起，比聊天便签多了可拒绝的竞争与版本边界。 [Q02](#research-q02) 仍保留宿主执行归属，工作流仅指导而非自动引擎。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) human actor是入口信任约定，不能约束已获CLI/数据库能力的进程；Goal complete与非空验证文本不证明成果合格，SQLite事务也不包外部副作用。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 提出版本、产物和真实验证记录绑定的验收包，检验能否减少误接受；相对现有human review新增可核材料，而非另设状态标签。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 用独立测试库和可丢弃目录从手动闭环试起，再显式开少量自动规则。出现重复执行、claim与会话不符或权限/预算不明，就暂停规则并对账外部副作用，保留数据库与附件。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 把持久任务、owner认领、宿主原生会话和人工review接在一起，比聊天便签多了可拒绝的竞争与版本边界。 [Q02](#research-q02) 仍保留宿主执行归属，工作流仅指导而非自动引擎。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) human actor是入口信任约定，不能约束已获CLI/数据库能力的进程；Goal complete与非空验证文本不证明成果合格，SQLite事务也不包外部副作用。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 提出版本、产物和真实验证记录绑定的验收包，检验能否减少误接受；相对现有human review新增可核材料，而非另设状态标签。 按 [Q03](#research-q03) 的竞争、非owner、旧版本和人工review检查后，再验证 [Q02](#research-q02) 的重启/取消与外部副作用；统计有效交付和恢复负担。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要跨会话管理本地项目的 DSH 操作者，可跟踪任务要求、claim与人工review，成果仍需独立验收。 本地任务清单、聊天笔记或外部看板可表达任务，本组件把任务版本、认领和原生会话连到同一库；不替代模型、文件权限或业务验收。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | Node ^22.19或>=24 | 本地库必需声明 | node:sqlite | 模块加载不代表GUI/执行兼容 | | DSH web、原生任务服务 | 看板必需；Agent服务按执行使用 | 客户端、会话、工具与模型 | 缺服务不形成相应执行能力 | | 同一已确认数据库与附件目录 | 持久化必需 | 任务唯一权威与附件 | 错库会看到不同事实，先对路径 | | 模型、preset和受控目录 | 自动执行必需 | 原生Agent办任务 | 需另控工具权限、预算与副作用 | | 宿主认证及本地CLI/DB权限 | 人类边界必需 | 约束accept和直接写库 | 本插件不是多租户隔离层 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 用户核实际profile、库/附件路径并备份 | 同一库、目录和权限明确 | | 加载 | 用户按作者命令安装重启 | 模块、GUI与工具分别确认，勿混为一次验收 | | 手动闭环 | 人工写验收条件，Agent精确版本认领并提交review | 非owner/旧版本拒绝，人工看产物后accept | | 自动评估 | 用户显式开启限量规则 | 核配额、claim、会话和费用，不以idle算完成 | | 退出 | 用户停规则并核工作者与外部动作，保留库/附件 | 状态对账后移除插件，不盲重放 | ## 成本与效果 [Q03](#research-q03) 的成本表分开模型资源、附件存储和人工验收/恢复，金额和时间未知。 [Q03](#research-q03) 的效果表只支持任务组织与权限接线，不输出净效率或生产可靠性结论。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定版本如何让看板、Agent执行与人工验收形成可追踪闭环，哪些状态不能当合格交付？ ### Q01 · 看板如何贯通人工任务、会话和工具？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 DSH Taskboard 面向本地项目中需要跟踪多会话任务、依赖和人工验收的操作者。任务卡、聊天笔记或外部看板是直接替代；该项目把本地持久任务与原生 Agent/Goal 执行连接，让对话活动不再是唯一任务记录。合格结果是任务要求、当前 owner、执行会话和验收理由可核对，卡片变色本身不算业务交付。 根插件创建 TaskboardService，并在宿主 tools 可用时注册工具，在 agents/goals/workspaceRegistry/presets/model 服务可用时建立 worker 与调度器。Agent 工具从 ToolRunContext 取得实际 Agent 标识，不让模型参数自由声明 human；任务认领使用精确版本，并在 SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE 事务内检查状态、已有认领、开发上下文冲突和未完成依赖，随后写 claim、任务状态与活动。相比仅在聊天中写“我正在做”，它有实际共享权威与竞争拒绝。 模型工具包含读、认领、评论、提交复核等，不提供 accept 或任意状态变更。provider.accept 强制 human actor 且只允许 in_review 到 done。不过 human 是入口权限约定，不是密码学证明真人点击；本地 CLI 直接构造该 actor，有本地执行/数据库权限的进程仍必须由宿主权限限制，见 Q02。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/client/index.tsx:1667-1718](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard/blob/69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5/src/client/index.tsx#L1667-L1718) 客户端创建控制器并注册sidebar与overlay，实际原生界面接线。

**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md:1-27](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard/blob/69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5/skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md#L1-L27) 包内Skill提供工具与人工review指导。
查看原文（27行） ```text --- name: manage-taskboard description: Manage work in the native DeepSeek Harness Taskboard with exact task ids and optimistic versions. Use when an Agent must inspect project work, claim an eligible todo, record progress or blockers, verify an implementation, submit it for human review, or release its own claim; also use when a human asks how to accept, return, archive, or automate Taskboard work through the native UI or dsh-taskboard JSON CLI. --- # Manage Taskboard Use the in-process `taskboard_*` tools for Agent work. Use `dsh-taskboard` only for human-operated scripts and interoperability; do not make the model shell out when a native tool exists. ## Execute one task 1. Call `taskboard_list` with the exact project id. Prefer an eligible `todo`; do not select `backlog`, archived, dependency-blocked, or already claimed work. 2. Call `taskboard_get` immediately before claiming. Preserve the opaque task id and current `version` exactly; never derive an id from a display key such as `DSH-42`. 3. Call `taskboard_claim` with that id and version. Treat a stale-version or claim conflict as a signal to reread and reconsider, not to retry blindly. 4. Read the full description, comments, relations, dependency state, development context, and attachment references before changing files. Work only in the task's declared workspace, branch, or worktree. 5. Complete the work and run relevant verification. If requirements change, call `taskboard_get` again before continuing. 6. Record the final result with `taskboard_comment` or `taskboard_submit_review`, always using the version returned by the latest read or write. Never modify the task description. 7. Call `taskboard_submit_review` with a concise result comment and concrete verification evidence. This moves owned work to `in_review`; it never marks work `done`. Keep every write version-linear: after any successful comment, relation, block, or other mutation, use its returned version for the next write. If another actor wins the race, reread the task and reconcile instead of overwriting their change. ## Handle exceptional outcomes - Call `taskboard_block` only on the in-progress task you hold the claim for, and only with a concrete reason when work cannot proceed. Include the missing dependency, decision, permission, or external condition. A `todo` you have not claimed is not yours to block: report the obstacle in a comment and leave the column to a human. - Call `taskboard_release_claim` when intentionally abandoning owned work. Explain what remains and leave useful progress in a comment first when possible. - Use `taskboard_relate` only after reading both tasks. Keep relations within one project and do not create parent cycles. - Never call or emulate acceptance. Only a human may accept `in_review` as `done`, return it for rework, approve backlog work, archive it, or permanently delete it. ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[README.md:5-30](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard/blob/69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5/README.md#L5-L30) 作者明确本地任务权威、宿主执行归属与人类验收定位。
查看原文（26行） ```text Native, local project task management for DeepSeek Harness. SQLite is the sole task authority. Harness Agent Sessions, Goals, Workspaces, tools, permissions, and the Web Client remain the execution and conversation owners. This README is written so a human **or another coding agent** can install the plugin into a live Harness profile, verify it, and start using it without guessing. **Package:** `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard` **Repository:** https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard **License:** Apache-2.0 **Host version policy:** DSH runtime peers use `*` (no version gate). Installation/loading is tested against `0.1.6-alpha.1`, `0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.2`. ### Q02 · 执行、取消和重启如何避免重复或失控？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 自动执行先同步认领，避免调度器把输掉事务竞争的任务当作已启动；再创建或恢复原生 Agent，安装模型选择和 preset，附工作区，发送包含任务版本、依赖、评论和附件引用的完整指令。赋给任务的 workflow 被渲染为 guidance-only，明确节点不会被调度器自动逐步执行，不能把工作流编辑器当已经运行的 DAG 引擎。 重启通过宿主现有 Agent 列表将缺席 owner 标为 orphaned，只恢复仍启用规则的相应 claim；恢复失败保留可见 orphaned。这个本地恢复机制有实质实现，但 SQLite 事务不包含 Agent、文件、模型与外部 API 的副作用。旧任务曾发出的命令是否停止、重放是否幂等，需要实际执行证据，单凭会话不在本进程列表不能推出远端已停。取消任务的数据库状态同样不能自行证明所有外部操作已撤销。 Goal complete 进入 in_review，不是 done，这是重要保护；但自动提交 verification 为 Completed，结果可取已有评论或通用 Work completed，并没有机器验证产物。最终仍依赖用户阅读实际成果。Web 写路由复用 connection.requestRejection 后使用 human:web-client，CLI 的 human(options) 在本地构造 actor；requireHuman 仅检查 kind。它隔离窄模型工具的权限，却不能约束已获 CLI 或数据库能力的 Agent，也不是多租户隔离。 调度器默认 quota 为 uncertain，pause-on-uncertain 会暂停新认领，而显式 ignore 可以继续；并发额度只限制 worker 数，不是模型费用预算。观察故障时须分别看任务库、claim、会话和实际副作用。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/execution/index.ts:175-199](https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard/blob/69a3db3b46ee04a960968af64a26f0ac901c82a5/src/execution/index.ts#L175-L199) 先认领、孤儿核对与启用规则条件恢复，失败仍可见。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# DSH Taskboard\n\nEnglish | [简体中文](README.zh.md)\n\nNative, local project task management for DeepSeek Harness. SQLite is the sole task authority. Harness Agent Sessions, Goals, Workspaces, tools, permissions, and the Web Client remain the execution and conversation owners.\n\nThis README is written so a human **or another coding agent** can install the plugin into a live Harness profile, verify it, and start using it without guessing.\n\n**Package:** `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard`  \n**Repository:** https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard  \n**License:** Apache-2.0  \n**Host version policy:** DSH runtime peers use `*` (no version gate). Installation/loading is tested against `0.1.6-alpha.1`, `0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.2`. This verifies installation and module loading; GUI operations and model execution still need checking after a Host upgrade.\n\n![Native Taskboard board, task detail, and workflow views](docs/assets/taskboard-demo.gif)\n\nIf you are an installing agent, jump to [Install into DeepSeek Harness](#install-into-deepseek-harness) and follow every step in order. Git, npm, and release tarballs carry prebuilt Host/Client artifacts. Installation requires neither a TypeScript build nor a Harness source checkout.\n\n## What you get\n\nAfter a successful install, Harness gains:\n\n- A **Taskboard** sidebar button and a native overlay page (not an iframe, not a second chat runtime)\n- Local SQLite projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments, workflows, and automation\n- Stable readable keys such as `DSH-42` plus opaque ids and optimistic versions\n- Seven statuses: `backlog` → `todo` → `in_progress` → `in_review` → `done`, plus `blocked` and `canceled`\n- In-process Agent tools `taskboard_*` (no accept / no generic status mutation)\n- Headless JSON CLI `dsh-taskboard`\n- Packaged Skill `manage-taskboard`\n\nAgents can submit verified work to `in_review`. Only an authenticated human UI or CLI operation can accept it as `done`.\n\nFurther design docs: [Architecture](docs/architecture.md), [Security and recovery](docs/security.md), [CLI reference](docs/cli.md), [Acceptance audit](docs/acceptance-audit.md). Attribution shipped to package consumers is in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.\n\n## Requirements\n\n| Requirement | Value |\n|---|---|\n| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (24 recommended; built-in `node:sqlite`) |\n| pnpm | Use `11.15.1` for repository development (`packageManager`); profile installation uses Harness's pnpm |\n| DeepSeek Harness | checkout or installation, **web** profile; no DSH version constraint |\n| Network | only needed to clone this repo and install Node dependencies |\n| Permissions | write access to `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`) and the ability to restart the Harness process |\n\nConfirm the toolchain before installing:\n\n```sh\nnode -v    # v22.19+ or v24+\npnpm -v    # 11.x\n```\n\n## Install into DeepSeek Harness\n\nUse these constants. Read live values from disk; do not invent a different package name.\n\n| Name | Value |\n|---|---|\n| Package name | `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard` |\n| Default profile | `web` |\n| Default Web port | `3080` (detect; do not assume) |\n| Profile directory | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>` , usually `~/.dsh/profiles/web` |\n| Packed tarball name | `shengsheng-dsh-taskboard-<version>.tgz` |\n\n`<version>` is whatever this repo's `package.json` currently declares — read it there rather than copying a number out of this document. After `pnpm pack`, use the tarball that was actually written.\n\nA longer copy-paste prompt for a Harness-side agent is in [docs/install-plugin-prompt.zh.md](docs/install-plugin-prompt.zh.md). The steps below are the normative English procedure.\n\n### 1. Detect the running Harness\n\nFind the Web listener and its working directory:\n\n```sh\nPORT=3080\nlsof -iTCP:\"$PORT\" -sTCP:LISTEN\n# then, with the listener PID:\nlsof -p <PID> -a -d cwd\n```\n\nIf nothing is listening on `3080`, search other common ports or ask the operator for the URL they use (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`).\n\nSet `PORT` to the actual listener port and keep using that value below. Use the running Host's `DSH_HOME` and profile; the examples use profile `web`.\n\nDecide how to invoke the `dsh` CLI:\n\n- If the Harness cwd is a source checkout (repo root has `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and `package.json` contains a `\"dsh\"` script), run every later command from that checkout root as `pnpm dsh ...`.\n- Else if `command -v dsh` succeeds, use `dsh ...` directly.\n\nIn the commands below, `dsh` means whichever of those two forms you just chose. First use of a profile may initialize it and install `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`.\n\n### 2. Choose a prebuilt installation source\n\nUse npm, Git (which includes `lib/`), or a GitHub release `.tgz`:\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add -w @shengsheng/dsh-taskboard\n# Alternatively:\ndsh plugin --profile web add -w git+https://github.com/shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard.git\n```\n\nFor the local tarball path in step 3, download a release `.tgz` and record its absolute path. Developers changing source run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm pack:release`. Consumer installation does not run a build. Release checks and CI validate completeness, source freshness, and compatibility. See [distribution and compatibility strategy](docs/plugin-compatibility.zh.md) for the verification boundaries.\n\n### 3. Add the plugin to the profile\n\nThe profile directory is a pnpm workspace root (`packages: [.]`). The `-w` / workspace-root flag is **mandatory**. Without it, pnpm fails with `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`.\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add -w /absolute/path/to/shengsheng-dsh-taskboard-<version>.tgz\n```\n\nIf you already installed through npm or Git in step 2, skip this step and continue to composition verification. Rebuild and run `pnpm verify:package` before installing a source checkout with local changes.\n\nThis command may rewrite the profile `package.json`, lockfile, and `node_modules`. That is expected.\n\nInstall succeeded only when **all** of the following are true:\n\n1. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` `dependencies` contains `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard`.\n2. The same file's `dsh.profile.bundles` lists `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard` **after** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`.\n3. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard/` exists and contains `lib/` plus `cordis.patch.yml`.\n\nIf the CLI warns `declares no dsh.bundle`, the package is missing `\"dsh\": { \"bundle\": { \"patch\": \"./cordis.patch.yml\" } }` in `package.json`. This repository already declares that; rebuild and reinstall rather than editing the installed copy by hand.\n\n### 4. Verify composition (does not start the server)\n\n```sh\ndsh --profile web --dump-config\n```\n\nPass when the dump ends with a `# == @shengsheng/dsh-taskboard` layer and the `taskboard` plugin config (`databasePath`, `attachmentRoot`, worker limits, and the other keys listed in [Configuration](#configuration)).\n\n`--dump-config` idempotently rewrites the profile-root `cordis.yml`. If a sandbox returns `EPERM` while writing `~/.dsh`, ask the operator for full filesystem permission and retry. That rewrite is expected, not a failure.\n\n### 5. Smoke-test module resolution\n\n```sh\n(cd \"${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web\" && node --input-type=module -e \\\n  \"import('@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard').then(m=>console.log('OK', m.name, typeof m.apply)).catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)})\")\n```\n\nPass: `OK taskboard function`.\n\nFail is usually a missing peer (`@deepseek-ai/*` or `react`). Those resolve through the install-fallback links under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` (usually `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`), which Harness heals on boot. Re-run step 4, then retry this import.\n\n### 6. See whether the running process already loaded the plugin\n\nPlugin composition and client-module scanning happen **only at boot**. Installing into the profile does not hot-load the UI.\n\n**After upgrading or reinstalling the package, restart Harness in step 7 even if both checks below pass.** The manifest contains the package name, not proof that the running Host loaded the new build.\n\n```sh\ncurl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/\" | grep -c '@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard'\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/plugins/@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard/client.js\"\n```\n\n- Manifest count `> 0` **and** bundle HTTP `200`, with no package changes since boot → client artifacts are served; skip the restart and go to [Confirm activation](#8-confirm-activation).\n- Otherwise restart Harness.\n\n### 7. Restart Harness\n\nRestart stops the process that hosts the current session. Session data lives in `$DSH_HOME/sessions` and is not deleted; in-flight Agent turns are interrupted. Tell the operator before restarting.\n\nFrom a Harness source checkout, a typical restart is:\n\n```sh\n# stop the current listener\nOLD_PID=$(lsof -tiTCP:\"$PORT\" -sTCP:LISTEN | head -1)\nif [ -n \"$OLD_PID\" ]; then kill -TERM \"$OLD_PID\"; fi\n\n# wait until the port is free, then start again from the checkout root\ncd /absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness\nnohup pnpm dsh --profile web >> /tmp/dsh-harness-restart.log 2>&1 &\n```\n\nDo not treat the first successful `GET /` as “plugin ready”. The Web server can accept connections before the boot manifest injects the plugin. Poll until the package name appears:\n\n```sh\nfor _ in $(seq 1 30); do\n  if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/\" | grep -q '@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard'; then echo ready; break; fi\n  sleep 2\ndone\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/plugins/@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard/client.js\"\n```\n\nA detached restart script used in a real install is documented in [docs/install-plugin-prompt.zh.md](docs/install-plugin-prompt.zh.md) (step 6). Prefer that script when the installing agent would be killed with the old Harness process group.\n\n### 8. Confirm activation\n\nAll of these must pass:\n\n| Check | Expected |\n|---|---|\n| `GET /` contains `@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard` | count ≥ 1 |\n| `GET /plugins/@shengsheng/dsh-taskboard/client.js` | HTTP 200 |\n| Harness boot log | no plugin import / apply error |\n| Browser | refresh `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`; a Taskboard control appears in the sidebar footer |\n| UI write | create a test project and task; refresh and confirm both persist |\n\nLoading the page alone does not verify the write channel. In browser developer tools, UI actions should POST to `/taskboard/<endpoint>` and return a `server-response` with `result.ok: true`. The channel uses Harness authentication and Origin checks. A `401` / `403` requires checking the browser login and Host access configuration; `404` indicates a missing route or an incorrect proxy path. HTTP `200` with `result.ok: false` is an application error, not a successful write. Custom RPC callers must send a `client-request` envelope with a string `rpcId`, a `method` matching the endpoint, and a `payload`.\n\nDefault data files (created on first use; the Host resolves these paths):\n\n```text\n.dsh/taskboard.sqlite\n.dsh/taskboard-attachments\n```\n\nThose defaults are **relative**, and a Host inherits its working directory from whatever started it, so they are never resolved against a raw process cwd. They bind to the nearest git project above the startup directory; configuration directories are not projects, so a versioned `~/.claude` or `~/.config/...` is skipped rather than written into.       "path": "skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: manage-taskboard\ndescription: Manage work in the native DeepSeek Harness Taskboard with exact task ids and optimistic versions. Use when an Agent must inspect project work, claim an eligible todo, record progress or blockers, verify an implementation, submit it for human review, or release its own claim; also use when a human asks how to accept, return, archive, or automate Taskboard work through the native UI or dsh-taskboard JSON CLI.\n---\n\n# Manage Taskboard\n\nUse the in-process `taskboard_*` tools for Agent work. Use `dsh-taskboard` only for human-operated scripts and interoperability; do not make the model shell out when a native tool exists.\n\n## Execute one task\n\n1. Call `taskboard_list` with the exact project id. Prefer an eligible `todo`; do not select `backlog`, archived, dependency-blocked, or already claimed work.\n2. Call `taskboard_get` immediately before claiming. Preserve the opaque task id and current `version` exactly; never derive an id from a display key such as `DSH-42`.\n3. Call `taskboard_claim` with that id and version. Treat a stale-version or claim conflict as a signal to reread and reconsider, not to retry blindly.\n4. Read the full description, comments, relations, dependency state, development context, and attachment references before changing files. Work only in the task's declared workspace, branch, or worktree.\n5. Complete the work and run relevant verification. If requirements change, call `taskboard_get` again before continuing.\n6. Record the final result with `taskboard_comment` or `taskboard_submit_review`, always using the version returned by the latest read or write. Never modify the task description.\n7. Call `taskboard_submit_review` with a concise result comment and concrete verification evidence. This moves owned work to `in_review`; it never marks work `done`.\n\nKeep every write version-linear: after any successful comment, relation, block, or other mutation, use its returned version for the next write. If another actor wins the race, reread the task and reconcile instead of overwriting their change.\n\n## Handle exceptional outcomes\n\n- Call `taskboard_block` only on the in-progress task you hold the claim for, and only with a concrete reason when work cannot proceed. Include the missing dependency, decision, permission, or external condition. A `todo` you have not claimed is not yours to block: report the obstacle in a comment and leave the column to a human.\n- Call `taskboard_release_claim` when intentionally abandoning owned work. Explain what remains and leave useful progress in a comment first when possible.\n- Use `taskboard_relate` only after reading both tasks. Keep relations within one project and do not create parent cycles.\n- Never call or emulate acceptance. Only a human may accept `in_review` as `done`, return it for rework, approve backlog work, archive it, or permanently delete it.\n\n## Guide human review\n\nAsk the human to open the native Taskboard task detail, inspect the result comment and verification evidence, then choose Accept or Return for rework. For headless human automation, use `dsh-taskboard task accept --task <opaque-id> --version <exact-version>` or `task return ... --comment ...`. Every successful CLI response is versioned JSON; exit codes distinguish usage, unavailable service, API errors, and optimistic conflicts.\n\nDo not bypass service policy with direct SQLite access, browser-side file access, generic status mutation, or prompt-only assumptions. The SQLite Provider and Host service are authoritative.\n"

      "content": "/** DeepSeek Harness host plugin for the native local Taskboard. */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'\nimport { TaskboardService } from './service/index.js'\nimport { registerTaskboardTools } from './tool/index.js'\nimport { TaskboardAutomationCoordinator } from './automation/index.js'\nimport { HarnessTaskboardWorker } from './execution/index.js'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace'\n\nexport * from './domain/index.js'\nexport * from './service/index.js'\nexport * from './sqlite/index.js'\nexport * from './tool/index.js'\nexport * from './workflow/index.js'\nexport * from './automation/index.js'\nexport * from './execution/index.js'\n\nexport const name = 'taskboard'\n\nexport interface Config {\n  readonly databasePath: string\n  readonly attachmentRoot: string\n  readonly pageSize?: number\n  readonly snapshotTaskLimit?: number\n  readonly maxAttachmentBytes?: number\n  readonly maxTaskAttachmentBytes?: number\n  readonly allowedAttachmentTypes?: string[]\n  readonly minAutomationIntervalMs?: number\n  readonly maxProjectWorkers?: number\n  readonly maxGlobalWorkers?: number\n  readonly allowSharedWorktrees?: boolean\n  readonly clientRefreshIntervalMs?: number\n  readonly maxChangeWaiters?: number\n  readonly maxChangeWatchMs?: number\n  readonly defaultAgentPreset?: string\n  readonly defaultModelRoute?: string\n}\n\nexport const Config: z<Config> = z.object({\n  databasePath: z.string().required(),\n  attachmentRoot: z.string().required(),\n  pageSize: z.natural().min(1).max(2_000).default(100),\n  snapshotTaskLimit: z.natural().min(1).max(2_000).default(1_000),\n  maxAttachmentBytes: z.natural().min(1).default(25 * 1024 * 1024),\n  maxTaskAttachmentBytes: z.natural().min(1).default(100 * 1024 * 1024),\n  allowedAttachmentTypes: z.array(z.string()).default([\n    'application/json', 'application/octet-stream', 'application/pdf', 'application/zip',\n    'image/gif', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'text/markdown', 'text/plain',\n  ]),\n  minAutomationIntervalMs: z.natural().min(1_000).default(30_000),\n  maxProjectWorkers: z.natural().min(1).default(2),\n  maxGlobalWorkers: z.natural().min(1).default(4),\n  allowSharedWorktrees: z.boolean().default(false),\n  clientRefreshIntervalMs: z.natural().min(1_000).max(300_000).default(15_000),\n  maxChangeWaiters: z.natural().min(1).max(1_024).default(128),\n  maxChangeWatchMs: z.natural().min(1_000).max(60_000).default(30_000),\n  defaultAgentPreset: z.string().default('standard'),\n  defaultModelRoute: z.string(),\n})\n\n/** Mount the Taskboard service and optional loopback Web RPC adapter. */\nexport function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {\n  const service = new TaskboardService(ctx, config)\n  ctx.inject(['tools'], (toolCtx) => { registerTaskboardTools(toolCtx, service) })\n  ctx.inject(['agents', 'goals', 'workspaceRegistry', 'agentPresets', 'agentDefaultModel'], (nativeCtx) => {\n    const worker = new HarnessTaskboardWorker(nativeCtx, service)\n    const automation = new TaskboardAutomationCoordinator(service, worker)\n    service.bindAutomation(automation)\n    nativeCtx.effect(() => {\n      let stopping = false\n      // Orphan reconciliation is best effort. Binding the scheduler to its success meant one\n      // transient failure (agents service not ready, SQLite momentarily locked) left this Host\n      // process with no automation timer at all until a restart.\n      void worker.reconcile().then(\n        () => { if (!stopping) automation.start() },\n        error => {\n          nativeCtx.logger.warn(`taskboard startup reconciliation failed: ${String(error)}`)\n          if (!stopping) automation.start()\n        },\n      )\n      return async () => {\n        stopping = true\n        await automation.stop()\n        await worker.stop()\n      }\n    }, 'taskboard: Agent execution and automation lifecycle')\n  })\n}\n"

      "path": "src/tool/index.ts",
      "content": "import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport type { ToolDefinition, ToolRunContext } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport { ProjectId, TaskId, TaskboardError } from '../domain/index.js'\nimport type { AgentActor, RelationKind, TaskStatus } from '../domain/index.js'\nimport type { TaskboardService } from '../service/index.js'\n\ntype JsonValue = null | boolean | number | string | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue }\n\nconst JSON_OUTPUT = {\n  schema: { type: 'json' as const },\n  render: (_args: unknown, value: unknown) => [{ type: 'text' as const, text: JSON.stringify(value) }],\n}\n\nfunction actor(exec: ToolRunContext): AgentActor {\n  const agent = exec.agent\n  if (agent === undefined) throw new TaskboardError('Taskboard tools require a live root Agent', 'TASK_FOREIGN_CLAIM')\n  const owner = String(agent.id)\n  return { kind: 'agent', actorId: owner, sessionId: owner, agentId: owner }\n}\n\nfunction present(title: string, rawInput?: unknown) {\n  return { card: 'generic' as const, title, kind: 'other' as const, ...(rawInput === undefined ? {} : { rawInput }) }\n}\n\nfunction asJson(value: unknown): JsonValue {\n  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as JsonValue\n}\n\n/** Build the narrow model-facing tool set. It intentionally contains no accept or generic status mutation. */\nexport function taskboardToolDefinitions(service: TaskboardService): ToolDefinition[] {\n  return [\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_list',\n      description: 'List bounded current tasks for one exact project. Read before selecting or mutating work. The result reports the matching total; pass offset to read past one page.',\n      parameters: {\n        project_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        statuses: {\n          type: 'array',\n          items: { type: 'string', enum: ['backlog', 'todo', 'in_progress', 'in_review', 'blocked', 'done', 'canceled'] },\n        },\n        include_archived: { type: 'boolean' },\n        search: { type: 'string' },\n        offset: { type: 'integer' },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args) {\n        const filter = {\n          projectId: ProjectId(args.project_id),\n          ...(args.statuses === undefined ? {} : { statuses: args.statuses as TaskStatus[] }),\n          ...(args.include_archived === undefined ? {} : { includeArchived: args.include_archived }),\n          ...(args.search === undefined ? {} : { search: args.search }),\n        }\n        const offset = Math.max(0, args.offset ?? 0)\n        const tasks = service.provider.listTasks({ ...filter, limit: service.config.pageSize, offset })\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson({\n          tasks,\n          offset,\n          total: service.provider.countTasks(filter),\n        }))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('List Taskboard issues', args.project_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_get',\n      description: 'Read the current task, exact optimistic version, comments, activity, relations, dependencies, and active claim before any write.',\n      parameters: { task_id: { type: 'string', required: true } },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.getTaskDetail(service.provider.getTask(args.task_id).id)))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Read Taskboard issue', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_claim',\n      description: 'Atomically claim one eligible todo after reading it. Pass the exact current version. The service rechecks dependencies and exclusive ownership in the same transaction.',\n      parameters: {\n        task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        const owner = actor(exec)\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.claim(TaskId(args.task_id), {\n          expectedVersion: args.expected_version,\n          sessionId: owner.sessionId,\n          agentId: owner.agentId,\n        }, owner)))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Claim Taskboard issue', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_comment',\n      description: 'Append a durable Markdown comment after rereading the task. Pass its exact current version; the write increments that version.',\n      parameters: {\n        task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n        body: { type: 'string', required: true },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.comment(TaskId(args.task_id), args.expected_version, args.body, actor(exec))))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Comment on Taskboard issue', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_submit_review',\n      description: 'Submit the owning in-progress claim for human review only after verification. Requires a result comment, verification evidence, and the exact current task version. This never accepts the task as done.',\n      parameters: {\n        task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n        verification: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        result_comment: { type: 'string', required: true },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.submitReview(\n          TaskId(args.task_id), args.expected_version, args.verification, args.result_comment, actor(exec),\n        )))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Submit Taskboard issue for review', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_block',\n      description: 'Block the in-progress task this Session owns, with a concrete non-empty reason and exact current version. A todo you have not claimed can only be blocked by a human.',\n      parameters: {\n        task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n        reason: { type: 'string', required: true },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.block(TaskId(args.task_id), args.expected_version, args.reason, actor(exec))))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Block Taskboard issue', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_release_claim',\n      description: 'Release only the current Agent Session claim, recording a reason. Read the task first and pass its exact current version.',\n      parameters: {\n        task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n        reason: { type: 'string', required: true },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.releaseClaim(TaskId(args.task_id), args.expected_version, args.reason, actor(exec))))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Release Taskboard claim', args.task_id),\n    }),\n    defineTool({\n      name: 'taskboard_relate',\n      description: 'Add one validated same-project parent, blocks, or related relation after reading both tasks. Pass the exact current source-task version.',\n      parameters: {\n        source_task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        expected_source_version: { type: 'integer', required: true },\n        target_task_id: { type: 'string', required: true },\n        kind: { type: 'string', required: true, enum: ['parent', 'blocks', 'related'] },\n      },\n      output: JSON_OUTPUT,\n      execute(args, exec) {\n        return Promise.resolve(asJson(service.provider.addRelation(\n          TaskId(args.source_task_id), args.expected_source_version, TaskId(args.target_task_id),\n          args.kind as RelationKind, actor(exec),\n        )))\n      },\n      presentCall: args => present('Relate Taskboard issues', args.source_task_id),\n    }),\n  ]\n}\n\n/** Register Taskboard tools into the active Harness tool runtime. */\nexport function registerTaskboardTools(ctx: Context, service: TaskboardService): void {\n  for (const definition of taskboardToolDefinitions(service)) ctx.tools.register(definition)\n}\n"

string): string {\n  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim().length === 0) {\n    throw new TaskboardError(`${label} must be a non-empty string`, 'TASK_INVALID_INPUT', { label })\n  }\n  return meta: { ...(cwd === undefined ? {} : { cwd }), agentPreset: rule.config.agentPreset },\n          agentOptions,\n          setup,\n        })\n      this.handles.set(initialClaim.sessionId, handle)\n       "content": "import { TaskboardError } from './error.js'\nimport { TASK_STATUSES, type TaskStatus, type TaskboardActor } from './types.js'\n\nconst HUMAN_ONLY = new Set([\n  'approve', 'return', 'accept', 'resume', 'cancel', 'reopen', 'archive', 'restore', 'delete',\n  'force-reclaim', 'move status', 'update comment', 'delete comment', 'rename project label', 'remove project label',\n])\n\n/** Parse a UI/CLI status token into the closed Taskboard vocabulary. */\nexport function parseTaskStatus(value: string): TaskStatus {\n  if (!(TASK_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(value)) {\n    throw new TaskboardError(`unknown task status ${value}`, 'TASK_INVALID_INPUT', { status: value })\n  }\n  return value as TaskStatus\n}\n\n/** Assert that an operation carries direct human authority. */\nexport function requireHuman(actor: TaskboardActor, operation: string): asserts actor is Extract<TaskboardActor, { kind: 'human' }> {\n  if (actor.kind !== 'human') {\n    throw new TaskboardError(`${operation} requires human authority`, 'TASK_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED', { operation })\n  }\n}\n\n/** Validate a source status for one intent-specific transition. */\nexport function requireStatus(current: TaskStatus, allowed: readonly TaskStatus[], operation: string): void {\n  if (!allowed.includes(current)) {\n    throw new TaskboardError(\n      `${operation} cannot move a task from ${current}`,\n      'TASK_INVALID_TRANSITION',\n      { operation, current, allowed },\n    )\n  }\n}\n\n/** Return whether an operation is reserved for humans. */\nexport function isHumanOnlyOperation(operation: string): boolean {\n  return HUMAN_ONLY.has(operation)\n}\n"

Unknown must stay unknown instead\n// of silently disabling `pause-on-uncertain`; operators can explicitly select `ignore`.\nconst DEFAULT_QUOTA: TaskboardQuotaPolicy = { state: () => Promise.resolve('uncertain') }\n\nexport const AUTOMATION_CANDIDATE_PAGE_SIZE = 500\n\n/** Claim failures that only mean \"this candidate is taken\", so the drain must try the next one.\n *  Treating them as fatal used to abandon the rest of the queue for the whole round. */\nconst CONTENDED_CLAIM_CODES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([\n  'TASK_INVALID_TRANSITION', 'TASK_ALREADY_CLAIMED', 'TASK_STALE_VERSION', 'TASK_DEVELOPMENT_CONTEXT_BUSY',\n])\n\n/** Host-owned durable scheduler that starts work but never steals an existing claim. */\nexport class TaskboardAutomationCoordinator {\n  private readonly timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()\n  private readonly inFlight = new Set<Promise<void>>()\n  private readonly inFlightByRule = new Map<string, Set<Promise<void>>>()\n  private readonly draining = new Set<string>()\n  private readonly runningByProject = new Map<string, number>()\n  private running = false\n  private rescanQueued = false\n  private unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly taskboard: TaskboardService,\n    private readonly worker: TaskboardAutomationWorker,\n    private readonly quota: TaskboardQuotaPolicy = DEFAULT_QUOTA,\n  ) {}\n\n  start(): void {\n    if (this.running) return\n    this.running = true\n    this.unsubscribe = this.taskboard.provider.subscribe(event => {\n      // Task activities carry taskId. Generic revisions cover project,\n      // workflow, and automation rows; coalesce them before re-projecting all\n      // durable rules so newly enabled rules start without a Host restart.\n      if (event.taskId === undefined) this.queueRescan()\n    })\n    this.rescan()\n  }\n\n  refresh(rule: AutomationRule): void {\n    this.cancelTimer(rule.id)\n    if (this.running) this.schedule(rule)\n  }\n\n  async runNow(ruleId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.tick(ruleId)\n  }\n\n  /** Extra drain that starts eligible work now without moving the durable schedule. */\n  async runImmediate(ruleId: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.draining.has(ruleId)) return\n    const scheduledAt = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(ruleId).nextEligibleAt\n    this.draining.add(ruleId)\n    try {\n      await this.drain(ruleId, this.running, {\n        preserveSchedule: true,\n        ...(scheduledAt === undefined ? {} : { scheduledAt }),\n      })\n    } finally {\n      this.draining.delete(ruleId)\n      if (this.running) {\n        const latest = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(ruleId)\n        this.schedule(scheduledAt === undefined ? latest : { ...latest, nextEligibleAt: scheduledAt })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async stop(): Promise<void> {\n    this.running = false\n    this.unsubscribe?.()\n    this.unsubscribe = undefined\n    this.rescanQueued = false\n    this.draining.clear()\n    for (const timer of this.timers.values()) clearTimeout(timer)\n    this.timers.clear()\n    await Promise.allSettled([...this.inFlight])\n  }\n\n  private schedule(rule: AutomationRule): void {\n    if (!this.running || rule.state !== 'enabled' || this.draining.has(rule.id)) return\n    const at = rule.nextEligibleAt ?? Date.now()\n    const delay = Math.min(Math.max(0, at - Date.now()), 2_147_483_647)\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n      this.timers.delete(rule.id)\n      void this.tick(rule.id)\n    }, delay)\n    this.timers.set(rule.id, timer)\n  }\n\n  private queueRescan(): void {\n    if (!this.running || this.rescanQueued) return\n    this.rescanQueued = true\n    queueMicrotask(() => {\n      this.rescanQueued = false\n      if (this.running) this.rescan()\n    })\n  }\n\n  private rescan(): void {\n    const rules = this.taskboard.provider.listAutomations()\n    const activeIds = new Set(rules.filter(rule => rule.state === 'enabled').map(rule => String(rule.id)))\n    for (const id of this.timers.keys()) if (!activeIds.has(id)) this.cancelTimer(id)\n    for (const rule of rules) this.refresh(rule)\n  }\n\n  private async tick(ruleId: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.draining.has(ruleId)) return\n    this.draining.add(ruleId)\n    this.cancelTimer(ruleId)\n    const coordinatorActive = this.running\n    let failure: unknown\n    try {\n      await this.drain(ruleId, coordinatorActive)\n    } catch (error) {\n      failure = error\n    } finally {\n      this.draining.delete(ruleId)\n    }\n    // The timer was cancelled on entry, so a thrown drain used to leave the rule with no timer at\n    // all: it stopped being scheduled until an unrelated rescan or a Host restart. Record the\n    // failure and re-arm instead.\n    if (failure !== undefined) this.reschedule(ruleId, failure)\n  }\n\n  private reschedule(ruleId: string, failure: unknown): void {\n    if (!this.running) return\n    try {\n      const latest = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(ruleId)\n      if (latest.state !== 'enabled') return\n      this.schedule(this.record(ruleId, {\n        kind: 'error',\n        message: failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : String(failure),\n        at: Date.now(),\n      }, Date.now() + latest.config.intervalMs))\n    } catch (_ruleUnavailable) {\n      // The rule was deleted or disabled while draining; there is nothing left to schedule.\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async drain(\n    ruleId: string,\n    coordinatorActive: boolean,\n    options: { readonly preserveSchedule?: boolean; readonly scheduledAt?: number } = {},\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    const preserve = options.preserveSchedule === true\n    const kept = options.scheduledAt\n    while (this.draining.has(ruleId)) {\n      if (coordinatorActive && !this.running) return\n      let rule = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(ruleId)\n      if (!preserve && rule.state !== 'enabled') return\n      const quota = await this.quota.state(rule)\n      if (quota === 'uncertain' && rule.config.quotaPolicy === 'pause-on-uncertain') {\n        rule = this.record(ruleId, {\n          kind: 'quota-paused', message: 'quota state is uncertain; no new claims started', at: Date.now(),\n        }, preserve ? kept : undefined, preserve ? undefined : 'paused')\n        if (!preserve) this.refresh(rule)\n        return\n      }\n      const inFlight = this.ruleInFlight(ruleId)\n      const slots = this.availableSlots(rule)\n      if (slots === 0) {\n        if (inFlight.size === 0) {\n          rule = this.record(ruleId, {\n            kind: 'empty', message: 'worker concurrency is currently full', at: Date.now(),\n          }, preserve ? kept : Date.now() + rule.config.intervalMs)\n          if (!preserve) this.schedule(rule)\n          return\n        }\n        await Promise.race(inFlight)\n        continue\n      }\n      let candidateOffset = 0\n      let candidates = this.taskboard.provider.listTasks({\n        projectId: rule.projectId, statuses: ['todo'], limit: AUTOMATION_CANDIDATE_PAGE_SIZE, offset: candidateOffset,\n      })\n      if (candidates.length === 0) {\n        if (inFlight.size > 0) {\n          await Promise.allSettled([...inFlight])\n          continue\n        }\n        const pause = !preserve && rule.config.autoPauseOnEmpty\n        rule = this.record(ruleId, {\n          kind: 'empty', message: 'no eligible todo tasks', at: Date.now(),\n        }, preserve ? kept : (pause ? undefined : Date.now() + rule.config.intervalMs), pause ? 'paused' : preserve ? undefined : 'enabled')\n        if (!preserve) this.schedule(rule)\n        return\n      }\n      let started = 0\n      let dependencyBlocked = 0\n      let contended = 0\n      while (candidates.length > 0 && started === 0) {\n        for (const task of candidates) {\n          if (started >= slots) break\n          try {\n            this.startWorker(rule, task)\n            started += 1\n            rule = this.record(ruleId, {\n              kind: 'claimed', taskId: task.id, message: `worker started for ${task.identifier}`, at: Date.now(),\n            }, preserve ? kept : undefined)\n          } catch (error) {\n            if (!(error instanceof TaskboardError)) throw error\n            // Losing a candidate to a dependency, to another owner, or to a busy development context\n            // says nothing about the rest of the queue. Only a genuine fault ends the round.\n            if (error.code === 'TASK_DEPENDENCY_INCOMPLETE') dependencyBlocked += 1\n            else if (CONTENDED_CLAIM_CODES.has(error.code)) contended += 1\n            else throw error\n          }\n        }\n        if (started > 0 || candidates.length < AUTOMATION_CANDIDATE_PAGE_SIZE) break\n        candidateOffset += candidates.length\n        candidates = this.taskboard.provider.listTasks({\n          projectId: rule.projectId, statuses: ['todo'], limit: AUTOMATION_CANDIDATE_PAGE_SIZE, offset: candidateOffset,\n        })\n      }\n      if (started > 0) continue\n      if (inFlight.size > 0) {\n        await Promise.race(inFlight)\n        continue\n      }\n      rule = this.record(ruleId, {\n        kind: dependencyBlocked > 0 ? 'dependency-blocked' : 'empty',\n        message: dependencyBlocked > 0\n          ? 'todo tasks are waiting for dependencies'\n          : contended > 0 ? 'every eligible todo is already owned elsewhere' : 'no worker started',\n        at: Date.now(),\n      }, preserve ? kept : Date.now() + rule.config.intervalMs)\n      if (!preserve) this.schedule(rule)\n      return\n    }\n  }\n\n  private availableSlots(rule: AutomationRule): number {\n    const globalAvailable = Math.max(0, this.taskboard.config.maxGlobalWorkers - this.inFlight.size)\n    const projectRunning = this.runningByProject.get(rule.projectId) ?? 0\n    const projectAvailable = Math.max(0, this.taskboard.config.maxProjectWorkers - projectRunning)\n    // The rule's own limit counts the rule's own workers. Measuring it against the project total\n    // let a sibling rule in the same project silently consume this rule's budget.\n    const ruleAvailable = Math.max(0, rule.config.concurrencyLimit - this.ruleInFlight(String(rule.id)).size)\n    return Math.min(globalAvailable, projectAvailable, ruleAvailable)\n  }\n\n  private ruleInFlight(ruleId: string): Set<Promise<void>> {\n    const existing = this.inFlightByRule.get(ruleId)\n    if (existing !== undefined) return existing\n    const created = new Set<Promise<void>>()\n    this.inFlightByRule.set(ruleId, created)\n    return created\n  }\n\n  private startWorker(rule: AutomationRule, task: TaskboardTask): void {\n    const projectId = String(rule.projectId)\n    const ruleId = String(rule.id)\n    this.runningByProject.set(projectId, (this.runningByProject.get(projectId) ?? 0) + 1)\n    let run: Promise<void>\n    try {\n      run = this.worker.start(rule, task)\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.decrement(projectId)\n      throw error\n    }\n    const ruleTracking = this.ruleInFlight(ruleId)\n    const tracked = run.catch((error: unknown) => {\n      try {\n        const latest = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(rule.id)\n        if (latest.state === 'enabled') {\n          this.record(ruleId, {\n            kind: 'error', taskId: task.id, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error), at: Date.now(),\n          }, latest.nextEligibleAt)\n        }\n      } catch (_bookkeepingFailed) {\n        // `drain()` awaits this promise. Letting the error log's own failure reject it turned one\n        // worker launch failure into a dead round for the whole rule.\n      }\n    }).finally(() => {\n      this.inFlight.delete(tracked)\n      ruleTracking.delete(tracked)\n      // Drop the per-rule bucket once it empties so a deleted rule leaves nothing behind.\n      if (ruleTracking.size === 0) this.inFlightByRule.delete(ruleId)\n      this.decrement(projectId)\n    })\n    this.inFlight.add(tracked)\n    ruleTracking.add(tracked)\n  }\n\n  /** Record a decision against the row's current version.\n   *  Workers settle while `drain()` awaits, so the version it read before an await is routinely\n   *  stale by the time it writes; a compare-and-set on that stale value threw out of the round. */\n  private record(\n    ruleId: string,\n    decision: AutomationDecision,\n    nextEligibleAt: number | undefined,\n    state?: AutomationState,\n  ): AutomationRule {\n    const latest = this.taskboard.provider.getAutomation(ruleId)\n    return this.taskboard.provider.recordAutomationDecision(latest.id, latest.version, decision, nextEligibleAt, state)\n  }\n\n  private decrement(projectId: string): void {\n    const next = Math.max(0, (this.runningByProject.get(projectId) ?? 1) - 1)\n    if (next === 0) this.runningByProject.delete(projectId)\n    else this.runningByProject.set(projectId, next)\n  }\n\n  private cancelTimer(ruleId: string): void {\n    const timer = this.timers.get(ruleId)\n    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer)\n    this.timers.delete(ruleId)\n  }\n}\n"
